title: LPEC pulse-position generation extracted from decompiled LPEC.dll

functions_analyzed.FUN_10004450: band pulse allocator: distributes per-subframe bit budget across bands and 3 value-codebook classes (4:2:1 bit-cost model), parity/byte fix-ups, leftovers to extra pulses
functions_analyzed.FUN_10003d80: per-band class split from band weight w and positions-per-band n (quadratic in w, factor 0x71c7 = 0.8567)
functions_analyzed.FUN_100060e0: pulse reader/placer: reads codes0+codes1+codes2 8-bit codes class-major then extras 1-bit signs; consumes value rows sequentially across bands; places values at record positions; sign 0 -> +0.6, 1 -> -0.6
functions_analyzed.FUN_1000c680: pitch-synchronous coarse-position word generator (not bitstream-driven): int16 LSF vector + scaled comb-shape value -> integer base; lag%3==0 window table DAT_10047f10 stride 1536/lag else DAT_10046f10 stride 2048/lag; output word = accumulator*0x2000 + (frac >> 6)
functions_analyzed.FUN_10005040: frame orchestrator: field order, per-type budgets, tail skip
functions_analyzed.FUN_10005bf0: LSF read: first stage-0 index stored to state+0x140+4*set (fallback +0x144+4*set) = band-weight row selector (pgidx)
functions_analyzed.FUN_10005ca0: lag/comb read: state+0xa0 lag bits (10 LP / 16 SP) + 6-bit comb shape when lag != 0

band_weight_tables.layout: 64 rows (6-bit LSF stage-0 index) x bands shorts; LP table 0x400 B

derived_algorithm.bit_economy: 8-bit code = 8 bits = one row of 2 (class0, 4 bits/value), 4 (class1, 2 bits/value) or 8 (class2, 1 bit/value) pulse values; extra pulse = 1 bit (sign)
derived_algorithm.pgidx: first LSF stage-0 index selects band-weight table row; weight calibrated per slot: w += (short)((budget - state[0xec+4*slot]) * state[0xfc+4*slot] >> 9)
derived_algorithm.allocator: per band: p0=((w*w>>15)*0x71c7>>15)*n>>15; p1=(((0x5000-(w>>1))*w>>14)^2>>15)*0x71c7>>13)*n>>15; p2=(w*n>>13)-4*p0-2*p1; if p2>n-p0-p1: p2=0, p0=((w-0x4000)*n+0x2000)>>14, p1=n-p0; then: sum(p0) even fix (p0->p1 as +2 units, stride-2 scan from end); sum(p1)%4==0 fix (direction by budget-cost<1); cost floor-aligned to multiple of 8 (drain or half-step grow of p2, capacity-capped); leftovers become extra pulses, per band capped so p0+p1+p2+p3 <= n
derived_algorithm.packing_order: codes0 codes then codes1 then codes2 (8-bit, MSB-first), then extras 1-bit signs; per band: class0,1,2 values from rows (row = table + rowlen*code*8, sequential consumption with cross-band carry), then extras at next record positions
derived_algorithm.positions: per band ppb records (16 B each); position = (FUN_1000c680 word & ~0x7F) | pulse_index_within_band; word stream per band advances ppb starting at state+0x40+4*slot
derived_algorithm.budget: slot_bits - 19; slot_bits = div2(remaining at type start) - (1 or 8 by pitch flag) for T0 halves; T1/T3: type total - consumed; T2: half at F then remainder at 5F/4

validation.method: Python port of FUN_10003d80/FUN_10004450 with raw table weights (calibration term zeroed), budgets and LSF-index rows from F-51 bit-exact parser
validation.interpretation: structural invariants (per-band capacity) hold on 100% of real subframes; exact bit-economy closure ~2/3-3/4 with raw weights; residuals attributed to unmodeled per-slot weight calibration (state+0xec/0xfc) and two port simplifications

negatives: FUN_1000c450 (FUN_1000c680 window preparation) and FUN_1000b110 (record initializer) not decompiled: Ghidra installation absent this session; characterized from caller evidence only
state+0xec+4*slot / state+0xfc+4*slot weight-calibration constants unattributed; allocator model uses raw table weights
FUN_1000c680 numeric path characterized but not reimplemented end-to-end; physical positions not synthesized in the validator
FUN_1000ef20 bit pump order taken from F-50/F-51 (not re-decompiled this session)
validation is structural (bit accounting, capacity, alignment), not sample-accurate PCM comparison
